name: B10-0468/2025 (ECR) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Serbia, one year after 16 people died when a railway station roof collapsed in Novi Sad. It says protests against corruption are genuine, condemns police violence against demonstrators, and criticises Serbia's president for visiting military parades in Moscow and Beijing. It calls on Serbia to protect free assembly, minority rights and fair public contracts, especially with Chinese state-owned companies.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Serbia's government, police and protesters, plus Chinese contractors there.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to the Council, the Commission and Serbia's government and parliament.
